background: BNG Bank is the Dutch public-sector bank, owned by the Dutch state, provinces and municipalities, which lends almost entirely to Dutch local authorities, housing associations and healthcare bodies and funds itself in the bond markets.
synthesis: Rated AAA on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, the highest standing on the site and backed by its public ownership. Capital is exceptional, with CET1 of 41.8% and leverage of 14.5% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks. Liquidity is strong too, LCR of 163% above the peer median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter. CET1 has risen 1.8 points and leverage 3.9 points since 30 Jun 2024, while LCR has fallen 11 points since 31 Dec 2021.
